Mail size standards (Jan 2026)
RULE · DMM 101
▾ tap
Letters: Min 5"×3½"×0.007" · Max 11½"×6⅛"×¼" · Max 3.5 oz
Flats: Over 11½" OR 6⅛" OR ¼" thick · Max 15"×12"×¾"
Postcards: Min 3½"×5" · Max 4¼"×6"
First-Class over 13 oz = Priority Mail
Nonmachinable surcharge: coins/keys, poly-wrapped, square, strings/wax seals, rigid

Sync & Save
Keep your data across all devices
💻
Option 1 — This device only (automatic)
Always on
Your data saves automatically to this browser every time you make a change. Works with no setup, no internet, no account. Data stays here as long as you don't clear your browser storage. Does not sync to other devices.
Last saved
—
Data items
0
📁
Option 2 — Export / Import (move data between devices)
Export everything as a file on one device, import it on another. Works anywhere, no internet needed. Use this to move your data from your computer to your phone or tablet.
To move data computer → phone:
1. On your computer: click Export all data → saves a .json file
2. Email that file to yourself OR put it in Google Drive
3. On your phone: open the email/Drive, download the file
4. Open this app on your phone → come to Sync/Save → click Import data → pick that file
📊
Option 3 — Google Sheets sync (automatic across all devices)
Connect a Google Sheet so every device reads and writes the same data automatically. Once set up, changes sync without needing to export/import. Requires a free Google account.
📋 One-time setup (about 10 minutes)
Step 1: Go to sheets.google.com → create a new blank spreadsheet → name it "PTF Clerk Log Data"
Step 2: In that spreadsheet → click Extensions in the top menu → click Apps Script
Step 3: Delete everything in the editor → paste in the script from the setup guide below → click Save (disk icon)
Step 4: Click Deploy → New deployment → Type = Web app → Execute as: Me → Who has access: Anyone → click Deploy
Step 5: Copy the Web App URL it gives you → paste it in the field below
Step 6: Copy your Sheet URL from the browser → paste it in the field below
Step 7: Click Save & test connection
⚠ Important: If you update the Apps Script later, you must Deploy → New deployment again (not just save). Google keeps serving the old version until you create a new deployment. Copy the new URL each time.
Apps Script — copy ALL of this
function doGet(e){return handleRequest(e,null)}
function doPost(e){return handleRequest(e,e.postData?e.postData.contents:null)}
function handleRequest(e,body){
  try{
    var ss=SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
    var sheet=ss.getSheetByName('PTFData')||ss.insertSheet('PTFData');
    var params=e.parameter||{};
    var action=params.action||'get';
    if(action==='ping'){
      return ContentService.createTextOutput(JSON.stringify({ok:true,ping:'pong'})).setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
    }
    if(action==='set'){
      var data=body||params.data||'{}';
      sheet.getRange('A1').setValue(data);
      sheet.getRange('B1').setValue(new Date().toISOString());
      return ContentService.createTextOutput(JSON.stringify({ok:true,saved:new Date().toISOString()})).setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
    }
    if(action==='get'){
      var val=sheet.getRange('A1').getValue();
      var ts=sheet.getRange('B1').getValue();
      return ContentService.createTextOutput(JSON.stringify({ok:true,data:val,saved:ts})).setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
    }
    return ContentService.createTextOutput(JSON.stringify({ok:false,error:'unknown action'})).setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
  }catch(err){
    return ContentService.createTextOutput(JSON.stringify({ok:false,error:err.toString()})).setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
  }
}

HAZMAT / Restricted / Perishable
Pub 52 reference · tap any item for details · add your notes
Fireworks 🚫 CANNOT MAIL ▾
Prohibited in all mail classes. Illegal to ship through USPS. · No services allowed
YOUR NOTES
Liquid mercury 🚫 CANNOT MAIL ▾
Prohibited. Toxic vapors. Antique thermometers — check before accepting. · No services allowed
YOUR NOTES
Small arms ammunition 🚫 CANNOT MAIL ▾
Prohibited. Pistol, rifle, shotgun ammo. Federal crime to mail. · No services allowed
YOUR NOTES
Explosives 🚫 CANNOT MAIL ▾
Prohibited. Any explosive device or component. · No services allowed
YOUR NOTES
Gasoline / flammable liquid fuels 🚫 CANNOT MAIL ▾
Prohibited. · No services allowed
YOUR NOTES
Marijuana / cannabis / THC products 🚫 CANNOT MAIL ▾
Prohibited under federal law regardless of state law. · No services allowed
YOUR NOTES
Drug paraphernalia 🚫 CANNOT MAIL ▾
Prohibited if illegal under federal, state, or local law. · No services allowed
YOUR NOTES
E-cigarettes / vaping products 🚫 CANNOT MAIL ▾
Prohibited to mail to consumers (PACT Act). · No services allowed
YOUR NOTES
Large lithium batteries (e-bike/EV) 🚫 CANNOT MAIL ▾
Prohibited in all mail classes. · No services allowed
YOUR NOTES
Perfume / cologne ⚠ CONDITIONS APPLY ▾
Ground only — no air. Consumer quantities. Leak-proof packaging. No international. · Allowed: Ground Advantage, Priority Mail (surface)
YOUR NOTES
Hand sanitizer / rubbing alcohol ⚠ CONDITIONS APPLY ▾
Ground only. Consumer quantities. Cannot go by air. · Allowed: Ground Advantage
YOUR NOTES
Aerosols (non-flammable) ⚠ CONDITIONS APPLY ▾
Domestic with conditions. No international. Check if flammable. · Allowed: FC Mail, Priority Mail, Ground Advantage
YOUR NOTES
Lithium batteries (small/consumer) ⚠ CONDITIONS APPLY ▾
Rigid packaging required. Pre-owned/damaged = ground only, mark "Restricted Electronic Device". · Allowed: FC Mail, Priority Mail, Ground Advantage (surface for larger)
YOUR NOTES
Dry ice ⚠ CONDITIONS APPLY ▾
Mark "Dry Ice" + weight on package. Max 5 lbs in PME. Allow CO2 to escape. · Allowed: PME, Priority Mail, Ground Advantage
YOUR NOTES
Cremated remains ⚠ CONDITIONS APPLY ▾
Priority Mail Express ONLY. Special USPS packaging. Label "Cremated Remains". · Allowed: Priority Mail Express ONLY
YOUR NOTES
Hemp / CBD products ⚠ CONDITIONS APPLY ▾
THC must be 0.3% or less. Keep lab test results 2 years. Pub 52 Section 453. · Allowed: FC Mail, Priority Mail, Ground Advantage
YOUR NOTES
Nail polish (flammable) ⚠ CONDITIONS APPLY ▾
Ground only for flammable types. Non-flammable = not regulated. · Allowed: Ground Advantage (surface)
YOUR NOTES
Safety matches ⚠ CONDITIONS APPLY ▾
Strike-on-box only, limited quantities. Strike-anywhere = PROHIBITED. · Allowed: FC Mail, Priority Mail
YOUR NOTES
Cigars ⚠ CONDITIONS APPLY ▾
Domestic OK. Cigarettes/smokeless tobacco very restricted — not to consumers. · Allowed: FC Mail, Priority Mail, Ground Advantage
YOUR NOTES
Alcohol / beer / wine ⚠ CONDITIONS APPLY ▾
Generally cannot mail. Very limited exceptions. Remove all alcohol labels from reused boxes. · Allowed: Very limited exceptions only
YOUR NOTES
Firearms (unloaded) ⚠ CONDITIONS APPLY ▾
Rifles/shotguns to FFL dealers OK. Handguns by licensed dealers only. Must be unloaded. · Allowed: To/from FFL dealers only
YOUR NOTES
Perishable food / fresh food ✓ MAILABLE ▾
Proper packaging to prevent leakage/odor. Recipient must receive promptly. · Allowed: PME (fastest), Priority Mail
YOUR NOTES
Eggs ✓ MAILABLE ▾
Cushioning and double-boxing required. · Allowed: PME, Priority Mail
YOUR NOTES
Plants ✓ MAILABLE ▾
Must comply with USDA quarantine. Check state restrictions. · Allowed: PME, Priority Mail, Ground Advantage
YOUR NOTES
Live bees ✓ MAILABLE ▾
Proper packaging per Pub 52 Section 526. · Allowed: PME, Priority Mail
YOUR NOTES
Books / Media Mail items ✓ MAILABLE ▾
No video games, computer drives, or non-media items allowed in same package. · Allowed: Media Mail (cheapest), FC Mail, Priority Mail, Ground Advantage
YOUR NOTES
CFL bulbs (fluorescent) ✓ MAILABLE ▾
Contain mercury vapor but allowed domestically. Package to prevent breakage. · Allowed: FC Mail, Priority Mail, Ground Advantage
YOUR NOTES
Prescription medications ✓ MAILABLE ▾
Authorized mailers (pharmacies). Personal use with documentation. · Allowed: FC Mail, Priority Mail, Ground Advantage
YOUR NOTES
Knives / pocket knives ✓ MAILABLE ▾
Not switchblades. Must be properly packaged. · Allowed: FC Mail, Priority Mail, Ground Advantage
